messages.subject: bam file error ---featureCounts
parts:
Hello,

There is an issue with featureCounts running to completion for a few of my bam files.
Paired-end libraries were de novo assembled  in CLC workbench. The contigs were mapped to a reference using bowtie2, and piped to samtools to generate a sorted bam file.

Running
./featureCounts -T 6 -t CDS -g ID -a bact.gff -o s1_trimmed_assembly_CDS_counts.txt s1_trimmed_assembly_sortcoord.bam

The following error is produced (also attached)



This bam file contains 875 reads.

I've re-run the file generation, both piping to samtools and running the sam to bam conversion separately), however they both generate the same error.

Can you help with resolving this issue?

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: f397ada1bf8e58b7
messages.subject: Re: bam file error ---featureCounts
parts:
Hello,

featureCounts processes only 116 of the 875 reads in my bam file, and produces this error:

A format error was detected in this BAM file.
The remaining part in the file is skipped.
Please check the file format using samtools.

Total reads : 116

A look at headers for reads 116-118 shows a complex CIGAR string of read 117, however it does match that read length (1058bp).
Some reads that preceed read 117 also have longer CIGAR strings and didn't cause any problems.

s1_forward_paired_(paired)_contig_1320  0       scaffold1.1|size2831460 711994  255     459M    *       0       0       AAAACGAAAT

s1_forward_paired_(paired)_contig_358   16      scaffold1.1|size2831460 730298  255     3M2I3M7I2M4I5M15I1M2I3M10I1001M *       0       0       CAGTTTCTATGATGAGGTAAAT

s1_forward_paired_(paired)_contig_194   0       scaffold1.1|size2831460 731296  255     1844M   *       0       0       AAGGGCGCTG

What else could be the causing featureCounts to stop processing this bam file at read 117?


Thanks again for your help,
Camille
